# Protocol: Intermediate File Cleanup

## Purpose
Define which files are permanent and which are intermediate after handoff to the implementation group, preventing accumulation of disposable artifacts.

## Permanent files (never remove)

| File | Reason |
|------|--------|
| `{SPECS_DIR}/domains/{domain}/openapi.yaml` | Technical contract — source of truth |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/domains/{domain}/{domain}.spec.md` | Business spec — source of truth |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/domains/{domain}/back/{domain}.back.md` | Back-end technical spec |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/front/screens/{screen}.screen.md` | Screen spec |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/front/_flows/{flow}.flow.md` | Flow spec |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/_global/conventions.md` | Global conventions |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/_global/error-codes.md` | Error code catalog |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/_global/glossary.md` | Glossary |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/openapi.root.yaml` | Domain aggregator |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/log-orchestrator-spec.md` | Session log |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/_validation/{domain}-validation.md` | Historical validation and triage record |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/domains/{domain}/out-of-scope.md` | Deferred and out-of-scope suggestions (cumulative) |
| `{SPECS_DIR}/compliance-report.md` | Compliance report (generated by the Validator when VALID) |

## Intermediate files (move to _temp/ after handoff)

| File | Reason |
|------|--------|
| Spec Reviewer review reports | Already consumed — issues resolved |
| Intermediate Spec Validator validation reports | Already consumed — final validation is what counts |
| Processed Change Requests (completed CRs) | Already applied to specs |
| Validation reports with Triage `COMPLETED` (after handoff) | Already consumed — can be archived |

## Procedure

After a successful handoff for a domain:

1. Verify that all permanent files exist and have `approved` status
2. Move intermediate reports to `{SPECS_DIR}/_temp/spec-{domain}/`
3. Create the `_temp/` folder if it does not exist
4. Record in the log: `Cleanup: {domain} — {N} files moved to _temp/`

## When NOT to clean up

- If the domain is still in the pipeline (handoff not completed)
- If there is a pending CR referencing the reports
- If the human requested keeping intermediates for auditing
